title: Canary pod restarting
customerImpact: Intermittent 502 on POST /api/v1/payments when pay-prod-east-2 restarts. pay-prod-east-1 remains healthy.

events.name: Jordan Voss
events.summary: Moved pay-prod-east-2 onto a smaller canary pod (memory 512Mi) to save cost. Set JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Xmx512m so the heap 'uses the limit'. Ticket BAYPAY-8066. pay-prod-east-1 unchanged (1536m heap, 2Gi).
